title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Time-resolved and Room-temperature Crystallography
about: The Paul Scherrer Institut (PSI) is recruiting a Postdoctoral Fellow in time-resolved and room-temperature crystallography for the Cryo2RT project at the Swiss Light Source and SwissFEL. Applications, with a publication list and two referees, are due 10 January 2027.
card_alt: Card for the Postdoctoral Fellow in Time-resolved and Room-temperature Crystallography at the Paul Scherrer Institut (PSI), Villigen, Switzerland, deadline 10 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Matterhorn above the village of Zermatt with a Swiss flag, not Villigen.
